description: Reads the board behind a Math Board link the user gave you and returns it as board text, in the same format you write. Ink, images, widgets and the audio of narration cannot be written as text and are listed as left out (narration text is kept, as :::say; the moods of the wire man as :::mood). For a live link it also says which page the teacher is on.

link.description: The Math Board link the user gave you, exactly as given: .../live/<id> (the board open now) or .../s/<id>#<key> (a shared copy).

name: read_board
title: Read a board
